main_text.l: חָלַם Somniavit: item ex Chaldaico usu Sanitati restituì, Convalescere. Hiphil הֶחֱלִים Somniare fecit: Sanitati restituit.
חֲלוֹם m. Somnium: plur. חֲלוֹמוֹת Chald. חֶלֶם, plur. חֲלֹמִין.
חָלַף Mutavit, Mutatus, Innovatus fuit: Praeteriit, Transivit: Exscidit, Concidit. Chald. Fut. יְחַלְּפוּן Praeteribunt, Dan. 4.13. Pihel חִלֵּף Mutavit. Hiphil הֶחֱלִיף Idem.
חָלַץ Pihel חִלֵּץ Exuit, Extraxit: Eruit, Eripuit; Subtraxit se. Niphal נֶחֱלַץ Liberari, Expediri, Expeditum esse. Hiphil הֶחֱלִיץ Expeditum reddidit.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are reproduced from a low-resolution scan and may not be exact. Several Hebrew forms, especially the Chaldaic and Pihel forms, are uncertain. The page has ink spots and show-through, which are not transcribed.
